content: {"like":["Excellent CGI in sci‑fi action films like Dawn of the Planet of the Apes","High‑quality Blu‑ray transfers for independent dramas such as Trans‑Siberian","Stunning special effects and cinematography in space‑drama Passengers","Strong visual storytelling in superhero epics like Man of Steel","Clear, detailed digital dinosaur imagery in Jurassic World"],"dislike":["Boring, long narratives in mainstream blockbusters such as Passengers and Dawn of the Planet of the Apes","Poor plot and acting in high‑budget action movies like Jurassic World","German‑only language and lack of subtitles in foreign films like Ein einfacher Plan","Low‑definition or missing HD transfers in classic titles such as On Golden Pond","Unnecessary double‑buying of film collections, e.g., The Godfather Collection"]}
